_meta.description: Index of reference data sources fetched for cross-checking NutriMom nutrient targets and food composition data
_meta.purpose: Document original authoritative sources and what data is available for verification

nutrient_target_sources.name: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements – Pregnancy (Health Professional)
covers: RDA/AI for 30+ micronutrients during pregnancy (14-18, 19-50 age bands)
UL values during pregnancy
Key nutrient guidance: calcium, choline, folate, iodine, iron, magnesium, omega-3, vitamin A/B6/B12/D, zinc
Supplement considerations and safety notes

nutrient_target_sources.name: EFSA Dietary Reference Values Summary Report (2017)
covers: EU Dietary Reference Values for vitamins, minerals, macros
Useful for EU vs US/Canada comparison
nutrient_target_sources.note: PDF download available at URL. Manual extraction or OCR needed for structured data.

food_composition_sources.name: USDA FoodData Central
food_composition_sources.content_type: Web API (REST, requires API key from data.gov)
covers: Food composition per 100g and per serving
Foundation foods, SR Legacy, branded foods, FNDDS 2019-2020
Searchable by food name or nutrient component

food_composition_sources.name: Health Canada – Canadian Nutrient File (CNF)
covers: 152 nutrients for 5690+ Canadian foods
Online searchable application (CNF 2015)
Nutrient Value of Some Common Foods (NVSCF) booklet: 19 nutrients for 1000 foods

food_composition_sources.name: CIQUAL Food Composition Table 2020 (ANSES, France)
food_composition_sources.content_type: Dataset (XLS + XML), French language, CC BY 4.0
covers: 3185 foods consumed in France
67 components: carbs, sugars, starch, proteins, fat/fatty acids, vitamins, minerals, energy
Values per 100g edible portion
food_composition_sources.citation: Anses. 2020. Ciqual French food composition table.

food_composition_sources.name: FAO/INFOODS/IZiNCG Global Food Composition Database for Phytate (PhyFoodComp)
covers: 3377 food entries for phytate content
19 food groups (mostly cereals, legumes)
Iron, zinc, calcium, water, phytate:mineral molar ratios
Values per 100g edible portion
Coded using FoodEx2 system
food_composition_sources.note: Specialized for phytate and mineral bioavailability. Not a general-purpose food composition database.
